priorityList: Maintain Blade Flurry at all times when 2 or more targets are present.
Use Adrenaline Rush on cooldown, ensuring it does not overlap with an existing buff.
Use Roll the Bones if no buffs are active or if you only have a single buff.
Use Keep It Rolling if you have 2 or more buffs (ideally 3) and Loaded Dice is not active.
Spend Combo Points when at Max - 1 (or Max - 2 if Between the Eyes is on cooldown).
Use Dispatch as a finisher if Slice and Dice is not active.
Use Between the Eyes as your primary finisher whenever available.
Use Killing Spree or Coup de Grace as high-priority finishers when available.
Use Dispatch as your default finisher to spend remaining Combo Points.
Use Blade Rush on cooldown for AoE damage and energy regeneration.
Use Vanish to trigger Hidden Opportunity if you have no Audacity or Opportunity procs available.
Use Ambush as your primary builder when Audacity or Hidden Opportunity is active.
Use Coup de Grace if the Disorienting Strikes buff is active.
Use Pistol Shot if Opportunity is active and stacks are capped or about to expire.
Use Sinister Strike as your filler to generate Combo Points.
